adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the decrypted payload is parsed and persisted without any schema validation: `symmetricDecrypt(...)` → `JSON.parse(...)` → `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key: keys } })` / `create({ data: { key: keys, ... } })`. This diff shows no Zod (or other) validation that `keys` matches the expected credential shape for the target app before writing to `credential.key`, so a malformed/incorrectly decrypted payload can be stored and break downstream credential consumers later.
